topic.label: Local approval or community input
topic.description: Whether local governments or residents should have a say before a data center is approved.
topic.suggested_question: What role should local residents and town governments have in approving a data center?

statement.quote_text: First and foremost, only local communities will be making these decisions. If a community says no data centers, then no data centers. As governor, we will not preempt local governments. They are the ones that issue building permits. If a local government says no, if a community says no, then there's going to be no data centers, period.
statement.context_before: clear when it comes to data centers.
statement.context_after: Number two, if a community does say they want to build
